description: Build a read-only diagnostic daemon that runs every 30 minutes and reports any Python daemon currently running under /home/workspace/ that is NOT registered in /etc/zo/supervisord-user.conf. This closes carryover #5 (supervisord persistence) by making missing-from-supervisord visible. Read /etc/zo/supervisord-user.conf as text, parse [program:NAME] sections, then enumerate ps -ef python processes and compare. Write findings to mesh_memory with agent_id='supervisord_audit' memory_type='persistence_drift' and emit a mesh_event when daemons-not-in-conf count is > 0. Exit 0 on no drift, 1 on drift. Pure read-only - never modifies supervisord-user.conf. Logs to /home/workspace/logs/supervisord_persistence_audit.log via FileHandler only (no StreamHandler).

context.author: CTO/CEO direct (Claude)
context.why_now: Builder queue empty for 80min; LLM and standing_goals fallback both producing 0 directives due to already_queued() globbing .done.json. This directive bypasses dirgen entirely.
constraints: ws_write for mesh_memory writes - never direct DuckDB
ISO 8601 string timestamps - never time.time() float
